snippet.title: Heartless - Indie Horror Game - No Commentary
snippet.description:
Thanks For Watching!

Facebook https://www.facebook.com/Stella-Abbasi-100150965166877/
Twitter https://twitter.com/StellaAbbasi

Download https://rotheart-games.itch.io/heartless

One year ago, Sarah vanished without a trace. The last place she was seen was Crimson Diner. For months, her husband, Jonathan, searched endlessly for answers until the trail went cold.

But now, a letter has arrived. From Sarah. The message is simple: Come to the diner.

This time, he’s not leaving without the truth.

Heartless is a short psychological horror game that blurs the line between love and obsession, grief and madness. As Jonathan explores the diner, he uncovers cryptic notes, twisted memories, and unsettling puzzles. But the deeper he goes, the more reality unravels.

Indie Horror Game Playlist https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLk0tZ0YT3FZEsIgd3Qdj19xGe9VcMMI1P

#heartless #Indiegames
